name: 帽兜娃娃
evolution: 大耳帽兜 → 帽兜娃娃 Lv.32 → 雪影娃娃 Lv.48 → 雪影冰灵
evolutionEn: Daermaodou → Maodouwawa Lv.32 → Xueyingwawa Lv.48 → Xueyingbingling
description: 头部浓密柔软的绒毛负责锁住热量，形成高效的保暖屏障，减少温度流失，兜帽形态的头部结构也可以有效防风。同种族喜欢聚集在一起，贴着脑袋，发热保暖。可能因为这种习性，它们产生了一些社会性。
descriptionEn: The dense, soft down on its head locks in heat, forming an efficient warm barrier that reduces heat loss; the hood-like head structure also effectively blocks wind. Members of the same species like to gather together, pressing their heads to generate and share warmth. Perhaps because of this habit, they have developed some social behavior.

skills.name: 风吹雪
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; restores 1 energy to self.

skills.name: 当头棒喝
skills.description: 造成物伤，若敌方本回合更换精灵，本次技能威力+100。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if the enemy switches this turn, this skill's power +100.

skills.name: 甜心续航
skills.description: 自己和敌方获得萌化：回复40%生命。
skills.descriptionEn: Self and enemy gain Fairy-charm: restores 40% HP.

skills.name: 超级糖果
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己获得萌化：本次技能威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; self gains Fairy-charm: this skill's power +60.

skills.name: 雾气环绕
skills.description: 回复能量，回复值等于敌方技能总能耗的一半。
skills.descriptionEn: Restores energy equal to half of the enemy's total skill energy cost.

skills.name: 冰墙
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：敌方获得2层冻结。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%; against attacks: enemy gains 2 layers of Freeze.

skills.name: 暴风雪
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得1层冻结。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy gains 1 layer of Freeze.

skills.name: 生日蛋糕
skills.description: 驱散自己的减益，自己的增益翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Dispels own debuffs; doubles own buffs.

skills.name: 撒娇
skills.description: 造成魔伤，3连击。自己获得萌化：威力永久+20。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, 3 hits; self gains Fairy-charm: power permanently +20.

skills.name: 冬至
skills.description: 将天气改为暴风雪，持续8回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Changes the weather to Blizzard for 8 turns.

skills.name: 冰晶坠
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得全技能能耗+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy gains +1 energy cost to all skills.

skills.name: 冰点
skills.description: 敌方获得5层冻结，应对防御：额外获得5层。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains 5 layers of Freeze; against defense: additionally gains 5 layers.

skills.name: 破罐破摔
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己有减益时，本次技能威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; when self has a debuff, this skill's power +60.

skills.name: 碎冰冰
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层冻结，本次技能威力+20。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for each layer of Freeze on the enemy, this skill's power +20.
